title: Host Fees Policy: Re-Rating the Host Service Fee in a Professional Tier — Host Accounts
content:
# Host Fees Policy — Re-Rating of the Host Service Fee in a Professional Tier (Host Accounts)

## Policy

1. When an account holds a professional tier whose host service fee percentage is lower than the percentage its stays were assessed at, the host service fee on each stay assessed on or after the tier start is re-rated and the difference is refunded, one refund for each stay, the most recently assessed stay first.

2. A stay's host service fee is assessed at the host service fee percentage of the account's tier when the stay's fee structure equals the tier's fee structure, and a re-rated fee replaces that percentage only for a stay re-rated under this rule.

3. A host service fee is not re-rated until the account holds the professional tier that its live listings and listing ratings qualify it for. In other words, while the professional tier on the Host Accounts record is not the one the account's live listings and listing ratings qualify it for, none of its host service fees is re-rated.

## Reading the policy

| Point | Under this policy |
|---|---|
| Accounts concerned | Host Accounts holders in a professional tier |
| Stays concerned | Stays assessed on or after the tier start |
| What is booked | One host service fee refund for each re-rated stay |
| Order between stays | The most recently assessed stay first |
| Reach of a re-rated fee | Only the stay re-rated under this policy |

## Booking the refund: `refund_rerated_host_fee_9248fd19`

**Capability.** The tool gives a host back part of the host service fee withheld on one stay, when that fee has been re-rated at a lower percentage. One call books one host service fee refund on the host account, dated today, tied to the stay, carrying the refund amount passed in; since no guest was refunded, the refund records no host-funded guest refund behind it. The refund reduces the host service fees the account has paid, and the host's account history then shows the refund against the stay.

**How it is invoked.** It is a support-side tool: unlock it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, giving the name `refund_rerated_host_fee_9248fd19`, then call it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `host_account_id` | The reference number of the host account the stay was hosted under, as returned by the host account lookup for the verified host | Reference number |
| `stay_id` | The reference number of the stay whose host service fee is re-rated, as returned by the stay lookup or shown on the host service fee record of that stay | Reference number |
| `amount` | The host service fee refunded | USD amount, 2 decimal places, positive; a value with more decimals is rounded half to even to the cent before it is booked |

**Return.** A one-line confirmation naming the refund record reference number, the stay, the booking date (YYYY-MM-DD, today's date) and the refund amount in USD to 2 decimal places. Its presence means the refund is on the account.

**Illustration (hypothetical values).** A call for host account HA-5005, stay ST-6006 and amount 9.00 returns a line stating that a host service fee refund was booked today for stay ST-6006: refund USD 9.00.
